verdict.rationale: The Sandbox API exposes a `region` parameter (modal-docs-32) alongside `cloud`/`gpu` options, implying some ability to select where compute (and by extension, sandbox data) runs, but there is no documentation framing this as a data residency/privacy compliance feature, no list of supported regions, and no statement about where persistent data/snapshots are stored. missing for 10: explicit data residency/compliance documentation, list of selectable regions, clarity on where snapshots/volumes/logs are stored relative to chosen region.
